args.title: Bellwether Office — Retail Returns Logistics (newsletter + article + companion)
args.body:
Combined three-bullet summary of the Bellwether Office newsletter on retail returns logistics, the linked article, and the subscriber-only companion piece.

Sources:
- Newsletter: "Retail returns logistics" (newsletter@bellwether.example)
- Article: https://blog.bellwether.example/2026/returns
- Companion (subscriber): https://insights.bellwether.example/returns/companion

Summary:
• Apparel return rates have reached 24%, making returns a material cost and capacity issue for retailers rather than a marginal one.
• Consolidating returns into dedicated hubs cuts handling cost by roughly a fifth (20%), the article's main operational lever.
• Speed to resale is the margin lever: the companion piece finds that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the original margin.

Access note: the companion piece is subscriber-only and was opened using the team subscription code (SUB-5333) supplied by Jonas.
